purpose: Explore one fourth-model candidate on training-side data after OOF/input diagnostics
status: training-side pilot; not adopted or integrated into the main runner
model: RBF support vector regression on explicit model-input band features
input_scaler: StandardScaler fitted within each fit partition
target_scaler: MinMaxScaler fitted within each fit partition
outer_training_validation: Reuse the saved 3 source-WAV-disjoint OOF folds of the existing models
inner_parameter_selection: 3 source-WAV-disjoint folds inside each outer training partition
inner_objective: Pooled clean RMSE; tie selects smaller C
stress_prediction_use: Descriptive transfer of clean-fitted fold models; never used to choose C
limitations: Feature family was chosen after inspecting training-side diagnostics, so the full design is exploratory
Both feature representation and model family change; this does not isolate architecture alone
Existing pooled OOF-derived ensemble weights are descriptive and not fully nested ensemble validation
Stress SVR predictions must not be combined with matched-trained baseline predictions as a clean-only ensemble
